title: Review broad except
why: Catching Exception or BaseException can hide programming defects and make unrelated failures look recoverable.
suggestion: Catch the expected exception types, or explicitly suppress BLE001 when a boundary must contain unknown failures.
limitations: Explicit Ruff BLE001 noqa directives, inline Pylint disables, and configured Pylint broad-exception suppressions are honored.
Handlers whose first executable statement rethrows or translates the exception are treated as explicit exception boundaries.
